## Coverage report

Totals: 104 REQs — 93 verified, 6 implemented, 5 approved, 0 draft, 0 needs-reverify. M10 is closed (1.1.0 released 2026-10-10); M12 is in progress (decomposed and approved 2026-10-12): STEP-M12-010 … 050 done — REQ-API-010, REQ-API-011, REQ-TOOL-024, REQ-TOOL-025, REQ-TOOL-027, REQ-TOOL-028 verified and REQ-NET-005 verified again; STEP-M12-060 and 100 implemented, in `doing/`, each waiting for one CI run. Of the 6 implemented, BUILD-002/004 and TOOL-001/002/014 stay as before — live/manual-only, by convention; BUILD-005 is proven by the release workflow runs (no `verifies:` test, like BUILD-002).

- **Approved REQs with no code tag (unimplemented):** REQ-BUILD-007 (080, 090), REQ-BUILD-008 (070), REQ-BUILD-009 (110, 120) — the expected set: approved 2026-10-12, their steps not yet started.
- **Code without a tagged passing test (unverified):** REQ-BUILD-002, REQ-BUILD-004, REQ-BUILD-005, REQ-TOOL-001, REQ-TOOL-002, REQ-TOOL-014. Tool/build REQs exercised manually or by running CI rather than by a `verifies:` unit test — TOOL-001/002 (status/checkin, driven live), TOOL-014 (reboot, disruptive/live — like TOOL-001/002), BUILD-002 (CI, self-verifying on each run), BUILD-004 (`./dev`), BUILD-005 (the release workflow runs). Behavior covered by the live gates.
- **Orphan tags (naming a nonexistent REQ):** none (100 distinct tagged IDs, every one resolves).
- **Broken architecture anchors:** none (REQ and step `traces.architecture` both checked).
- **`done/` steps with empty `evidence.commits` (hygiene):** M1-030, M1-040, M1-050, M1-060, M1-070, M1-080, M1-090, M1-100, M1-110, M10-010, M10-020, M10-030, M10-040, M10-050, M10-060, M2-040, M2-045, M2-050, M7-080 — non-blocking, the step's test/notes evidence is present.

The approved M12 REQs carry, by design, (a) one OPEN criterion each where the step must settle a fact first — REQ-BUILD-006 (settled by STEP-M12-060: Ubuntu's libcurl has no static closure, MSYS2's has; no static CI leg), REQ-BUILD-007 (compressed-point ECDSA on OpenSSL 3), REQ-BUILD-009 (Windows `libwolfssl.dll.a` in the companion asset; the exact OpenSSL 3.5.x pin), REQ-TOOL-026 (`-static`/UCRT interplay; wrong-version DLL on PATH) — resolved and recorded by the step named in each (REQ-TOOL-028's was settled by STEP-M12-050); and (b) attended criteria for the M12 gate (REQ-TOOL-026, REQ-TOOL-028 — the wizard run on Linux and Windows consoles —, REQ-BUILD-009; REQ-TEST-007 convention). REQ-TOOL-026's "linking proven at decomposition" box is checked (2026-10-12). Every pre-M12 criterion stays closed — NONE open since the M10 gate.
